title: Kapp1xel's OP Weapons
description: 5 new OP weapons: Catzuka, Mallet, Nokia 3310, Autoburner 3000 and an Anti-Gravity Slingshot
body:
**This mod adds the weapons from my video "I Coded OP Weapons Into Minecraft"**

# Go Check Out The Original Video
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/DMjl66ShbpI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


![All the weapons in the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c0dc65e6cc01553bf86892c2f6b534acfae7e34.png)

## This Mod Is Incredibly Fun To Mess With, Especially With Your Friends

# ⚔️ Weapons' Information

 _Mallet_ - Knocks enemies back
 
 _Autoburner 3000_ - Burns any entity
 
 _Nokia 3310_ - Deals 1000 Damage
 
 _Catzuka_ - Turns any entity into a cat
 
 _Anti Gravity Slingshot_ - Makes any entity levitate

# 🐛 BUGS:
-There is a bug known where if you kill a chicken it doesn't drop the cooked version of the food

Bugs will not be fixed as this mod was made simply for a video

# 📂 Version Information:
This mod is for version 1.21.8, it won't be ported.
There are no incompatibilities known

No dependencies


I don't allow changes to the mod, but you can freely add it to modpacks no need to ask.
